summary: Full e2e test of iteration_123 Supplier Portal features: new test@test.com login (vendor H1330), vendorCode-in-URL routing, extra PO columns (PO From/PO Date/Unit Price/Subtotal), PO search, PO detail modal with PO Total, multi-PO shopping-cart shipment creation with 2-step confirm, testing-only vendor impersonation (?as_vendor), new Shipments page with edit-until-locked flow (PUT /shipments/{code}), and internal /admin/grn-approval multi-PO regression. Backend: 17/17 pytest cases pass. Frontend: every requested flow works end-to-end and persists. Found 1 HIGH backend code bug (SAP GR posting can never succeed - KeyError 'namespace' in the SOAP envelope format call) plus a handful of medium/minor gaps (cart still enabled while impersonating, legacy shipments show blank PO Numbers, buyer-entity fallback deviates from spec).

critical.issue: sap_gsa_write_client.py:_ENVELOPE_TEMPLATE contains the placeholder {namespace} but .format(items=..., doc_code=...) never passes `namespace`, so every approve raises KeyError('namespace') BEFORE any HTTP call to SAP. UI shows 'SAP posting pending - namespace' and sap_gr_result.reason="'namespace'". This is NOT a SAP-side/authorization problem - the real GR post is unreachable in its current form. Internal approval itself is correctly recorded (status -> Received).

minor.issue: Both ignore the ?as_vendor testing override and always use account['vendor_code']. While impersonating another vendor the dashboard cart is fully enabled but submission fails with a confusing 400 'Item 1 was not found on Purchase Order 28663'. Either honour as_vendor in testing mode or disable the cart/checkboxes while impersonating.

sap_po_client.buyer_entity_name() maps only {'RI','RT'} and falls back to the raw buyer_code (or '-'). Spec said 'RAY INTERNATIONAL for RI, RADISH TECHNOLOGIES otherwise' - any third/blank buyer code will render a raw code instead of the default entity name.

Pre-migration shipments (F2EJT7, Q7YA7Z) created under the old top-level po_number schema have items without po_number, so the new 'PO Numbers' column renders blank on BOTH the vendor Shipments page and the internal GRN pending list. Needs a one-off data migration (copy top-level po_number into each item) or a display fallback.

ui_bugs.issue: PO rows with remaining/open qty of 0 still render an enabled checkbox + ship-qty input; selecting one only fails at submit time with a backend 400 instead of being disabled up front

Checking a line item (or adding one in the edit dialog) pre-fills ship qty with the FULL remaining quantity (e.g. 10000/17000). One accidental click-through creates a shipment for the entire open PO qty - suggest defaulting to blank/1
ITEMS column shows cryptic 'item_number x qty' pairs (e.g. '3 x 9, 3 x 10000') with no product description or PO context; the internal GRN detail table is much clearer

integration_issues.issue: Dashboard cart works visually while impersonating vendor B2551 but 'Yes, Generate Code' fails (400 item-not-found) because POST /shipments ignores as_vendor

issues: Company name / vendor code block in the header is hidden on small screens (only search + Shipments + Sign Out visible); vendor code is only visible in the sub-heading
PO table needs horizontal scrolling with 10 columns - acceptable but PO From/PO Date wrap heavily

action_items: FIX HIGH: pass namespace=<GSA SOAP namespace> into _ENVELOPE_TEMPLATE.format() in /app/backend/sap_gsa_write_client.py - currently every GRN approval's SAP post dies with KeyError('namespace') before any HTTP request

Decide impersonation semantics: either honour ?as_vendor in POST/PUT /supplier-portal/shipments when SUPPLIER_PORTAL_TESTING_MODE=true, or hide the cart/checkbox column while impersonating so testers don't hit a misleading 400
Migrate (or add display fallback for) legacy shipments whose items have no po_number - PO Numbers column is blank for F2EJT7 / Q7YA7Z on the vendor Shipments page and the GRN pending list
buyer_entity_name(): default to 'RADISH TECHNOLOGIES' for unmapped/blank buyer codes as specified, instead of echoing the raw code
Optional UX: disable checkbox/qty for zero-open-qty rows, and don't pre-fill ship qty with the entire remaining PO quantity
critical_code_review_comments: sap_gsa_write_client._ENVELOPE_TEMPLATE.format(...) is missing the `namespace` kwarg -> guaranteed KeyError on every call; add a unit test that formats the envelope so this can't regress silently.

supplier_shipment_service.create_shipment/update_shipment_items take the full account dict but only ever use vendor_code/_id/company_name - passing an explicit vendor_code would let the testing-mode override work consistently across GET/POST/PUT.

get_cached_pos_with_remaining() runs one aggregate per cached line item (_shipped_qty_so_far in a loop) - fine at 10 rows, but O(N) round trips; consider a single $unwind aggregate keyed by (po_number,item_number) if vendors ever have hundreds of open lines.

TESTING-ONLY code (SUPPLIER_PORTAL_TESTING_MODE, _effective_vendor_code, /supplier-portal/testing/vendor-directory, the header search box) is well flagged - keep a single pre-launch checklist item to delete it.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified working: login->/dashboard/H1330 (and bare /dashboard + /shipments redirect to the vendor code), 10 PO rows with PO From=RAY INTERNATIONAL / PO Date / Unit Price / Subtotal all populated for POs 28792/28833/28897, PO search by number/product-id/description + no-match state, PO detail modal with computed PO Total (28792 = Rs 5,16,480), multi-PO cart -> floating bar -> Review dialog (editable qty + remove) -> SEPARATE 'Generate Shipment Code?' dialog -> 6-char code (no dialog skipping, no premature POST), impersonation to B2551 (URL + real different PO data), Shipments page list + Edit dialog (qty change, add via search from another PO, remove) with 'Save these changes?' confirm and verified persistence after reload, approved shipment becomes read-only (no Edit), GRN page shows multi-PO 'PO Numbers'. IMPORTANT ENV GOTCHA: uvicorn --reload watches /app/backend, so creating/editing files under /app/backend/tests restarts the backend and API calls time out for ~2 min - wait ~60-90s after writing a test file before running it (my first pytest run failed entirely for this reason). Regression suite: pytest tests/test_supplier_portal_iter123.py (pytest.ini already forces xdist loadscope, so keep per-class fixtures self-contained).
rca_of_the_issue: SAP GR posting failure RCA: sap_gsa_write_client.py builds the SOAP envelope with _ENVELOPE_TEMPLATE.format(items=items_xml, doc_code=...) while the template also contains xmlns:n0="{namespace}"; str.format raises KeyError('namespace'). approve_shipment catches all exceptions and stores sap_gr_result={'ok':False,'reason':"'namespace'"} with sap_sync_status='pending', which is why the GRN UI reports 'SAP posting pending - namespace' - i.e. no SAP request is ever sent. Reproduction: lookup any in_transit code on /admin/grn-approval and click 'Approve & Post to SAP'. Mitigation: supply the GSA namespace constant to .format().
